text: かざんの　どうくつは　どうやって　できるか　しってる？

structure.jp: かざんの　どうくつは
どうやって　できるか

patterns.name: 〜か (embedded question)
patterns.span: どうやって　できるか
patterns.explanation: A question ending in か can sit inside a bigger sentence as the thing you know or ask about. どうやって　できるか　しってる？ = 'do you know how they form?'

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: てる is the spoken short form of ている. 'To know' in Japanese is always said this way, as a lasting state. しってる？ = 'do you know?'
